newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India tenders to buy 89,000/T butane for September.
newsitem.headline: India tenders to buy 89,000/T butane for September.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a tender to buy 89,000 tonnes of butane for delivery in September, an industry source said on Tuesday.

The tender seeks three cargoes of 13,000 tonnes each for delivery to Vizag on the east coast, and two and three cargoes of 10,000 tonnes each to Mangalore and Kandla respectively, both on the west coast.
The tender closes August 6 and offers should be valid until August 9. Offers can be made on both a cost-and-freight or free-on-board (fob) basis, the source said.
IOC is expected to award more than the 49,000 tonnes it purchased for August delivery, the source said.
"From now onwards, the country is building up for the winter," the source said. But the source declined to project demand.

For August, IOC purchased through tender, three cargoes of 13,000 tonnes to Vizag and one 10,000 tonne cargo to Mangalore at a $5 per tonne discount to the Saudi benchmark Contract Price, on a fob basis, the source said.
